subject: Discovery recap: MedMetrics POC readiness and open-model shortlist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha@medmetrics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: MedMetrics POC readiness and open-model shortlist

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so we have aligned expectations going into a short POC: 

Pain points you called out:
- High per-token spend on current OpenAI usage for billing and summarization workflows (est. $60k/mo).
- Latency spikes at peak hours impacting real-time billing notifications.
- Concern about vendor lock-in and data exportability / auditability.

Current stack notes you shared:
- Frontend: React app + server-side Node.js render services.
- Current LLM traffic: OpenAI text-generation + small Anthropic experiments for safety checks.
- Streaming use for incremental billing notifications; KV cache currently not externalized.

Success criteria for the POC (agreed):
1) Latency under 250ms tail for 512-token responses for billing-notify path.
2) Metric parity with current model on accuracy of line-item extraction (>92% F1 on our sample prompts).
3) 30–40% reduction in per-token unit cost (or comparable monthly spend).
4) Demonstrable ability to route traffic to an open-model variant with transparent quantized performance.

Recommended short model shortlist (initial):
- meta-llama-3-mix (quantized 8-bit; good balance latency/quality)
- mosaicml-mpt-30b-instruct (for higher-context summarization)
- openchat-7b-v2 (fast, good for routing/fallback)
(we'll validate with your prompts during the POC)

Next steps (action owners & timing):
- Ben: share POC checklist and model shortlist (attached) + proposed PoC runbook by EOD Tue (8/10).
- Asha/Tom: share 1) a sample set of 200 prompts/responses (anonymized), 2) high-level throughput curve (QPS vs hour) and 3) SOC/email for security contact. Target: Wed 8/11.
- Neha: scope integration effort (auth, streaming hooks) and estimate engineering uplift for a 4-week POC (by Fri 8/13).
- Marcus: prepare cost comparison template and preliminary quantization tradeoffs.

Attachments: medmetrics_poc_checklist.xlsx, redwood_model_shortlist.pdf (contains model perf notes + cost estimates).

If that aligns, I'll lock a 3-week POC that runs against a reserved cluster and we can do an internal demo after week 2 with the accuracy metrics.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

--
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM serving; https://redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Discovery recap: MedMetrics POC readiness and open-model shortlist

Ben —

Appreciate the clear notes. This matches our view; a couple clarifications from my side after syncing with Tom and security: 

1) Data residency: we need logs/audit trail kept for 13 months in a private S3 (us-east-1). Can your private deployment support that? Marcus, any initial notes here?
2) For the sample prompts — we'll redact PHI but need help validating redaction doesn't break the evals. I can send those by EOD Wednesday.
3) On cost: the $60k/mo number is an internal estimate; we can share more granular billing (token buckets) but will need an NDA addendum for billing CSVs.

One more ask: Tom wants to know whether Redwood can run the POC against both a hosted and a private deployment to compare latency/cost. Is that feasible under one PoC?

Thanks,
Asha

Asha Patel
VP Product, MedMetrics
asha@medmetrics.com | +1 (650) 555-2299

Thanks Asha — quick answers and confirmation of next steps.

On data residency / audit logs: yes — Redwood Private can write audit logs and request traces to a customer-managed S3 in us-east-1 for 13 months. I'll loop Marcus to capture the exact ACL/KMS requirements. (Marcus: see action item below.)

On hosted vs private POC: doable. Proposed approach:
- Week 1–2: run parallel runs — hosted Redwood API for quick iteration + private deployment (VPC) to capture realistic network latency and S3 audit trails.
- Week 3: compare quality and cost; if open-model latency is within your SLO we can test a gradual cutover in a canary route.

Action items updated: 
- Ben: send PoC runbook + contract addendum for NDA/billing CSV access (today). Link to runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMedMetricsPOC
- Asha: share anonymized prompts + throughput curve (target Wed 8/11 EOD).
- MedMetrics Security: share acceptable encryption/KMS thumbprints OR confirm we can use your KMS key for S3 (need by Fri 8/13).
- Neha: estimated engineering uplift for 4-week POC (due Fri 8/13).
- Marcus: audit log storage ACL/KMS checklist (due Thu 8/12).

I'll also attach a short template NDA addendum for billing CSV access and a checklist for sample redaction guidance. If everyone agrees, I'll open a HubSpot opportunity and draft the SOW for a 3-week POC (ballpark price: reserved cluster + integration hours; we'll firm up after scope).

Thanks all — will follow up with the runbook and the short checklist.

Best,
Ben Carter
